distortions.detail: payload "4 in university campus" dropped the noun/verb ("cuatro [estaciones] se instalarán"); decode "4 will be on the university campus" does not say stations, and the decoder flagged it could be 4 bikes

"costó" (past) decoded as present "the project costs about €1.2 million"; key says news=past but decoder treated "Ferrer:" lines as present-tense reported speech, and the lemma "cost" is tense-ambiguous
"y 4 en el campus universitario": stations not stated, "se instalarán" lost; 4 bikes is an open reading
"el proyecto costó" decoded as "el proyecto cuesta" (present)

source says toilets will not flush (inability, and the reason to store water); payload wrote "toilet ! flush" instead of the lemma "cannot", so under notice=imperative it decoded as a prohibition: "Do not flush the toilet"; the because/so link to storing water was also lost
"トイレの水も流れませんので" (toilets won't flush, so...) decoded as "トイレを流さないでください" (please do not flush)
